blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V141 renders shows visible faceted torso triangles and breaks at the side, waist, and hip/skirt junction. The torso-to-skirt transition remains discontinuous despite the section-centered contour direction.

The skirt still reads as a stiff, uniformly flared cone with only faint vertical panel divisions. The waist join retains a hard projecting shelf and jagged side intersections; section-centered radial placement did not resolve the visual continuity defect.
Crouch exposes thighs, sitting collapses the skirt into a rigid billow, and prone lifts it into a broad boxy/fan-like drape. Pose coverage remains unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
